candidates.title: NASA ends Swift observatory mission ahead of re-entry
candidates.summary: Swift (launched Nov 2004, built for 2 yrs) made final observation Oct 20 2026; NASA announced end Oct 23. Orbit decayed due to solar-activity-swollen atmosphere; no propulsion; Katalyst LINK rescue failed; re-entry expected within weeks; >2,000 GRBs, >1,400 supernovae; ~12 TB public archive.
candidates.note: SELECTED
